records.name: British Columbia Harbours Board

firstSeen.locator: Harbour Board Repeal Act, SBC 1983 c. 5, assent heading and s. 3 ("the board is dissolved")

records.endedMeaning: dissolved, its members' appointments ending, when sections 2-3 of the Harbour Board Repeal Act came into force (OIC 1061/1985; Public Accounts 1984/85, C24 note 19(b)); its assets and liabilities went to BC Development Corporation and BC Railway Company under sections 4-5, on days not recovered
records.description: Provincial board that held harbour and port-railway assets under the Harbour Board Act; dissolved on 30 May 1985, its assets divided between BC Development Corporation and BC Railway Company. Its start is not in this research: BC Archives gives 1967, which needs the Harbour Board Act and its commencement before it is used; until then it is drawn from the 1983 Repeal Act, the first source here that shows it.
records.kind_note: Kind crown-corporation follows its listing with the Crown corporations in the Public Accounts notes; the Act calls it a board. Check against the Harbour Board Act.
